catalogue.comment:
SHARED CATALOGUE LIBRARY

This catalogue is a compiled reusable artifact for Harlequin units. It is not a semantic source of truth; the Universal Unit Skeleton remains authoritative.

The library owns intrinsic unit data: points, loadout trees, paid wargear, unit-internal list-building rules, attachment associations, and reusable semantic categories.

Consumer catalogues own availability, configuration gating, primary presentation categories, and host-army-specific restrictions. Consumer catalogues should link these sharedSelectionEntries instead of copying the unit trees.

ERROR UX PASS V1
Harlequin Leader attachment validation now uses standardized custom player-facing errors. missing_attachment replaces the stock 'needs 1 more unit selected in Attaches To' message. leader_host_limit replaces the stock 'associations too many' host error. The underlying attachment UI and legal states are unchanged.

ERROR UX PASS V2 - RARE LIMIT
Solitaire and Death Jester now prototype the standardized rare_limit custom error. This pass intentionally tests whether a roster-scoped custom error attached to a repeatable unit definition renders once or duplicates across multiple selected instances.

GAME SYSTEM REVISION 9
Leader Capacity validation now comes from the shared Game System custom error rather than the hidden category's stock max constraint.

REV7 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No shared unit costs, loadouts, attachment validation, host categories, or library semantics were otherwise changed.

REV8 POLISH PASS
Added explicit model headers to single-model Harlequin units, flattened Troupe Players 4-5 into the normal Loadout Options hierarchy, removed the redundant 'Choose either:' presentation label from the three Troupe baseline melee choices, and standardized Solitaire / Death Jester Rare error wording. Leader attachment associations, Troupe host-limit validation, paid grenade wargear, points, categories, and all loadout legality are otherwise unchanged.

REV9 RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS
Revisited the Harlequins shared library against the final cross-faction presentation standard. Standardized the Light, Dark, and Twilight Troupe host Leader-limit errors to grammar-safe 'This unit...' wording. Rewrote all ten shared-unit authoring comments as current-state durable notes, removing obsolete Phase 0.1 / prototype labels and retiring the old Solitaire / Death Jester Rare-error test notes. Loadouts, defaults, paid wargear, association mechanics, Rare validation, points, categories, shared unit IDs, and all other rules semantics remain unchanged.

REV10 / GS17 TROOP COPY COST SUPPORT
Updated the shared Harlequins library to Game System revision 17. Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe now carry the hidden Counts Toward Troop Soft Copy Cost semantic category and shared Additional Copy Costs reminder rule. The three Troupes remain separate copy families; their allowances do not pool. No generated, free, or otherwise exempt Troop unit exists in the shared library. All loadouts, Leader attachment semantics, shared unit IDs, costs, and other intrinsic unit data remain unchanged.

V11 — TROUPE BASELINE ATOMIC PACKAGES
Updated Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe. Their Troupe Players 1-3 blocks now choose between 3x Harlequin's Kiss & Shuriken Pistol and 3x Power Sword & Shuriken Pistol. Removed the redundant fixed 3x Shuriken Pistol branch from each unit. Troupe Players 4-5, points, categories, copy-cost accounting, Leader behavior, and all unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

REV12 — GS20 TROOP COPY RULE
Updated to Game System revision 20 and retargeted Light Troupe, Dark Troupe, and Twilight Troupe to the Additional Copy Cost - Troop short-form rule. Existing shared unit IDs, infoLink IDs, Troupe loadout packages, points, categories, and unrelated library semantics are unchanged.

REV13 — HARLEQUINS 3.3.5 VERSION SYNC
Updated the shared library title from Harlequins 3.3.3 - Library to Harlequins 3.3.5 - Library to match the playable adapter. No shared unit trees, IDs, loadouts, validation, categories, copy-cost participation, or other mechanics changed. Patch Notes remain owned by the playable Harlequins catalogue rather than the reusable library.
